class.name: JRPGProjectSetup
class.brief_description: Makes a project ready for the JRPG workspace (Project > Tools > Set Up JRPG Project...).

method.name: create_starter_database
method.description: Returns the starter database (not saved): every table with a few original entries, System data titled [param game_title] with a new game id and the hero as the starting party, and the default types and terms.

method.name: get_default_input_actions
method.description: Returns the [code]jrpg_*[/code] actions and their default events as a [Dictionary] of [Array]s of [InputEvent]: arrows, WASD (physical keys), Enter/Space/Z to confirm, Escape/X/Backspace to cancel, Tab/M for the menu, Shift to dash, Q/E and Page Up/Page Down to change pages, and the matching gamepad buttons and left stick.

method.name: run
method.description: Runs every step and returns a report [Dictionary]: [code]changed[/code] (whether anything was created or added), [code]created[/code] (folders and files), [code]input_actions_added[/code], [code]input_actions_kept[/code], [code]enabled_setting[/code] ([code]turned_on[/code] or [code]already_on[/code]), [code]game_id[/code], [code]addon[/code] (the report of [method JRPGManagedAddon.install]) and, when a step failed, [code]error[/code] with what went wrong and how to fix it.
